title: Hayati Pro Max Strawberry Kiwi Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Strawberry Kiwi blends the sweetness of ripe Strawberry with the tangy freshness of Kiwi for a bright, well-balanced fruit vape. The Strawberry offers a soft, juicy flavour, while the Kiwi adds a sharper, slightly tropical note that brings delicious contrast and clarity to the mix. Crafted with nicotine salts for rapid satisfaction and a more comfortable throat hit, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices such as pod kits and vape pens. Its 50VG/50PG ratio ensures discreet vapour and reliable flavour delivery. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
